title: Secure Credentials and Mobile Solutions for Users and Connected Vehicles
lead: High-assurance identities for connected vehicles, fleets, workshops, and mobility ecosystems.
seoDescription: Scytáles solutions for connected vehicles and the transportation sector — secure credentials online and offline.

sections.heading: The challenges
points: Consumers expect security, connectivity and convenience.
Manufacturers face the same rising expectations.
Sustainability targets are reshaping the industry.
EU regulations are accelerating the shift.
Automotive and mobility are moving toward connected vehicles.
Fleet software must hold vehicle and driver data in one place.
Connected vehicles join the internet over IoT.
They share data continuously with other devices and systems.

sections.heading: Our approach
bullets: All produced ECUs and diagnostic tools
All employees and diagnostic tools within the company, its suppliers, customers and affiliated companies
All workstations and their employees and diagnostic tools
sections.lead: Vehicles, drivers and workshops share one verified identity layer. A fleet can prove who is who over any standardized protocol, in the workshop or remotely, and stay ready for connected goods, charging, autonomous operation and V2X as those arrive.

sections.heading: Why choose Scytáles
rail: Compliant with UN and EU regulations and standards — eIDAS, NIST, ETSI, PIV, and EU/UNECE.
Customers stay independent of deviations in national security laws.
And of upcoming changes to those laws, across their own factories and workshops globally.
Enabled-ready for future verification of connected goods.
Ready for electrical charging, autonomous and V2X scenarios.
